scope: Sweep callback allocation failures through the legacy and R24 rich-cell TABLESTYLE DXF writers at their admitted revision boundaries.

profiles: Legacy: one TABLESTYLE with three row styles, six ordered borders per row, and one emitted TEXTSTYLE dependency.
R24: one TABLESTYLE with default Table plus title/header/data cell styles, six ordered borders per rich style, and one emitted TEXTSTYLE dependency.

checks: Every measured callback allocation failure is reached and refuses the write
The existing destination sentinel is unchanged after each refusal
The caller TABLESTYLE remains unchanged after each refusal
Same-codec retry reproduces the calibrated clean bytes
Fresh typed readback validates the TABLESTYLE identity, owner, names, legacy row values, and R24 cell-style IDs, names, and border vector

limitations: Generated transaction evidence only; no producer interoperability or native TABLESTYLE semantics are established.
Generated transaction evidence does not qualify producer interoperability, native TABLE presentation, or semantic interpretation of TABLESTYLE values.
